name: voice.piper-voices
title: Voices (Piper)
summary: The Piper provider of voice.list: the Piper voices installed in the voice folders, with language, quality, sample rate and speaker count.
description: Lists every <name>.onnx with its <name>.onnx.json config in the voice folders (MX_VOICES_DIRS, /voices in Docker). Pass an id as voice to voice.speak with provider piper, or to voice.piper. Reads only the configs, never the models, so it is instant.

search.description: Keep only voices whose name, language or labels contain this text (case-insensitive), e.g. en_GB or high.

voices.description: The installed voices, sorted by name.

id.description: Voice name to pass as voice.

language.description: Language code from the config, e.g. en_US.

num_speakers.description: Speakers in the model; pick one with speaker.
